dedup_rule.note: Mirror of engine/fusion/fusion_policy.cc DedupKey(); the content test pins the equality. NFC and NFD stay distinct, matching the candidate contract tests.

score_scale.note: Raw source scores from different backends are never added together. Order inside the fallback band is the producer insertion ordinal; no uncalibrated scale participates.

raw.evidence: eval/candidate-v1-r3: raw is the hard tier
raw.note: The raw tier is a hard rule, not a score; it always precedes suggestions.

expansion.note: Exact expansions keep their hard protection inside the fallback band: the merger hoists an exact_expansion row above non-exact rows of its own band.

calibration_basis.eval/candidate-v1-r3: Recorded candidate-menu evaluation (evaluator schema v3, see docs/reports/phase-e-multilingual-fusion.md). Established that prediction, conversion, word/morphology and expansion rows each live on their own log-like scale and are not comparable as raw numbers.
calibration_basis.merge/producer-probe-r1: Merge probe over the recorded menus: NormalizeToPoints with rank-only sources reproduced every recorded winner and left single-language menus byte-identical. This is the recorded basis for shipping all non-raw sources as restricted fallback in policy v1; flipping any source to calibrated requires a new recorded evaluation and a version bump.
